description: This file handles WiFi spectrum analysis via AJAX, including functions for MAC address translation, result retrieval from WiFi diagnostics, and session checks for user login status. It also includes routines to initiate WiFi diagnostics and output the results in JSON format.

methods.name: mac_translate
methods.description: Transforms MAC address strings into standardized colon-separated uppercase format.

methods.name: rearrange_SDTR
methods.description: Reformats a comma-separated string by adding line breaks or special characters after certain entries.

methods.name: get_results
methods.description: Fetches neighboring WiFi diagnostic results, processes data, and returns a success or in-progress status with data.
